description: Simulation watchlist. Every connector reads this file. Add or remove tickers freely; there is no limit. Each entry is either a ticker string, e.g. "MSFT", or an object with an optional name, e.g. {"ticker": "NET", "name": "Cloudflare"}, and an optional news_query (the words the RSS news search uses instead of the name). Without a name, the company name is taken from the SEC list.
